$comment: Default field values for the 'public-api' security profile. MarinOS has no public-api application yet — this exists ahead of need, per standard.md. referrerPolicy and frameProtection are 'not-applicable' rather than 'not-achievable': they're meaningless for a service with no rendered HTML page, not blocked by hosting. If a public-api app ever serves any HTML (e.g. a docs page), revisit those two fields for that surface specifically. CSP only applies at all if the service serves HTML somewhere; a pure JSON/data API has nothing for a <meta> CSP tag to sit inside.

contentTypeOptions.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

permissionsPolicy.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

frameProtection.notes: No rendered HTML page to clickjack for a pure data API.
